findings.statement: Rank 1 in convergence ranking (score 4.5197, 5 streams). Open Targets overall association 0.3088. Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 9.712). Cell-membrane protein (UniProt Q16790; also microvillus membrane), so antibody/imaging accessible. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. DepMap: no ccRCC dependency (mean effect 0.051, selectivity 0.031, none of the lines dependent), and no recurrent mutation (1 of 511 patients). It is therefore a surface biomarker and antibody or imaging target, not a functional dependency.

Rank 3 in convergence ranking (score 4.2143). Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 7.09). Cell-membrane ligand of CD27 (UniProt P32970). Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB PHASE_1, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. Untested in approved ccRCC therapy and tractable by antibody/ADC. DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.251, selectivity 0.006), so the case rests on surface expression, not on essentiality.

Rank 29 in convergence ranking (score 3.2997). Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 5.557), apical cell membrane and secreted (UniProt O14638). Drug: AGS-16C3F PHASE_2, an antibody-drug conjugate. DepMap selectivity 0.026 means no selective dependency. It is a tractable antibody target with clinical precedent in RCC.

Established ccRCC drug target (HIF-2 alpha). Open Targets association 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN APPROVAL. Tractability: small-molecule approved drug and PROTAC-relevant ubiquitination labels. Reactome includes cellular response to hypoxia and regulation of PD-L1 transcription. It is one of the few genes with a selective DepMap dependency: ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs 0.157 in other lines, selectivity 0.3, padj 0.061, 0.208 of ccRCC lines dependent, not common essential. Low mutation frequency (0.004).

Top Open Targets ccRCC association (score 0.6466). Recurrent somatic driver: 247 of 511 tumours mutated (freq 0.483), padj 0.0. Loss of VHL drives HIF stabilisation, upstream of EPAS1. DepMap selectivity is -0.835, so ccRCC lines are not selectively dependent on it (it is a tumour suppressor). Not directly druggable, with no drugs listed.

Rank 7 in convergence ranking (score 3.9643). Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 4.685) with protein up (log2FC 2.709). Prognostic: TCGA Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479 (higher expression, worse survival). Open Targets association 0.0598. No drugs. DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.316, selectivity -0.075), so it is a biomarker and mechanistic candidate, not a validated target.

Rank 5 in convergence ranking (score 4.1052). Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 3.989). Open Targets association 0.4049, with genetic association component 0.519. No drugs in the record; tractability is predicted only (components value 0.5). DepMap shows no dependency (mean effect 0.002), so it is tractable but untested.

Rank 2 in convergence ranking (score 4.2206). Strongly down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -4.741, protein log2FC -2.273). Prognostic: Cox log HR -0.358, padj 0.000023 (higher expression, better survival). Open Targets association 0.0701. No drugs. DepMap selectivity -0.01, so it is a loss-type diagnostic and prognostic marker, not a target.

Rank 4 in convergence ranking (score 4.1667). Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -6.154, protein log2FC -2.264). Prognostic: Cox log HR -0.402, padj 0.0000433. Drugs: PROBENECID PHASE_4, PRATOSARTAN PHASE_3 (transporter substrates or inhibitors, not ccRCC therapy). Open Targets association 0.0662. Proximal-tubule identity marker lost in ccRCC.

Rank 15 in convergence ranking (score 3.5532). Tumour-up (TCGA log2FC 3.291, protein log2FC 2.279). Open Targets association 0.0491. No drugs listed; tractability predicted only. DepMap mean effect -0.015, selectivity -0.008, so there is no dependency evidence. Untested tractable candidate (lactate transporter, glycolytic phenotype).

Rank 6 in convergence ranking (score 4.0695). Open Targets association 0.4532 with genetic association 0.7338, among the top 25 ccRCC associations. Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -3.721, protein log2FC -1.235). No drugs. Association-driven biomarker with no dependency (selectivity 0.078).

caveats: Most top convergence genes (CA9, CD70, NNMT, SCARB1, SLC16A3) show no ccRCC-selective DepMap dependency; their case is surface expression or biomarker value, not essentiality. Only EPAS1 shows selectivity (0.3, padj 0.061).
DepMap and mutation records for CA9, CD70 and NNMT returned evidence_id null and cannot be cited; their values are quoted from the convergence_ranking row where available.
Tractability for many ranked genes is predicted, not clinical. Drug names and stages are taken as returned by Open Targets, and some (probenecid, pratosartan, sulthiame) are not ccRCC therapies.

Tools were not called for STRING interactors, and the OT association, DepMap and mutation checks were not run for every ranked gene. The tool-call budget went to the highest-ranked and established targets.
The ranking is dominated by down-regulated proximal-tubule genes (ALDOB, SLC22A8, UMOD, etc.), which reflect tissue-of-origin loss and are biomarker candidates only.
